Level 1  
Pronunciation and Delivery  
 Some simple familiar words are pronounced accurately enough to be understood.  
Communication strategies  
 Some very basic comprehensible responses are given.  
Vocabulary and language patterns  
 Several examples of simple v ocabulary are used appropriately.  
 A few simple formulaic language patterns are used appropriately.  
Ideas and organization  
 Basic relevant information is offered when the topic is very familiar.  
 Some brief responses or statements are made when repea tedly prompted.
